Answer me with HTML
in Shimo Style
An agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML in Shimo Docs style.
Markdown in. One self-contained page out. No server, no build step.

## Why this fork?

Answer me with HTML already turns a Markdown draft into one clean HTML
page. This fork adds a **proj

ect-native Shimo Docs theme** and makes it the default, so every page looks like a document
someone
would actually read.

| | Original | This fork |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| CLI, drafts, components, videos | ✅ | ✅ unchange

d |
| Themes | blueprint · shadcn · paper · 3b1b | + **`shimo`**, built in and default |
| Look | te

chnical board / cards / paper | white square page on `#f7f7f7`, 30px/700 title, 15px/1.7 body |
| Qu
ality | — | `0 errors · 0 warnings`, WCAG AA contrast |
## ✨ Features

| Feature | What you get |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🎨 **Shimo Docs by default** | White page, thin gray rul

es, neutral grays and one accessible Shimo blue. |
| 📄 **One file, offline** | The output is a singl

e HTML file with inline CSS and JS. No server, no CDN. |
| 🧩 **Real components** | Tables, code bloc

ks, callouts, flow / sequence / ER diagrams, charts, timelines, trees and math. |
| 🌗 **Light & dark

** | Both palettes are token-driven and pass the theme's contrast checks. |
| ⚡ **Fast** | The model

writes a short Markdown draft; the bundled CLI does layout and SVG coordinates. |
| 🧪 **Controlled
writing** | The STE check flags wordy sentences and overlong paragraphs before the page is written.

## 🚀 Install
You need Node.js 20 or newer. There is no `npm install` step: the CLI is bundled inside the skill.
### Let your agent install it
Paste this into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness or another agent:

> Install Answer me with HTML in Shimo Style: read
> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kanzakivnw/an
swer-me-with-html-in-Shimo-Style/main/INSTALL.md and follow it.

## 🎨 The Shimo look
The theme follows measurements from the Shimo editor (2026-10). Nothing is hand-waved: the tokens be

low are the same
ones the theme checks and ships.

| Element | Value | Where it shows |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Canvas | `#f7f7f7` | page background |

| Paper | `#ffffff` + `0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.13)` | square page with a quiet shadow |
| Title / bod

y | `30px/700` · `15px/1.7` | document title and prose |
| Ink | `#3a3a3a` · `#6b6b6b` · `#9a9a9a` |

text, secondary text, metadata |
| Rules | `#e7e7e7` · `#efefef` | table borders and hairlines |
|

Fill | `#f5f5f5` | table headers, code blocks, inline code |
| Accent | `#2b68c2` | links, focus rin

gs, highlights |
| Diagram | `#d5dae1` strokes · `#eaf2fe` highlights | flow, sequence, ER, charts |

The theme source is `src/themes/shimo.js`. A user theme with the same name in
`~/.answer-me-with-htm
l/themes/shimo.json` would shadow it; do not install one if you want the built-in version.
